DIAGNOSIS READY: Major Depressive Disorder with psychotic features.

The clinical picture of persistent sadness, significant weight loss/sleep disturbance, concentration issues, and mood-congruent auditory hallucinations (voices telling her she is worthless) over four months, in the absence of substance use, strongly points to this diagnosis. The hallucinations appearing after the onset of severe depressive symptoms suggest the psychotic features are secondary to the depression.
